name: Build Breaker
author: Brett
description: Everything Brett ever asked for, in plain English (build-asks@1): one compact row per ask with its date and time, a status badge (built, in progress, pending, planned, held, removed, waiting for push / pull / deploy / approval), build time, cost and model. Grids per app and per plugin plus a timeline; search, status / model / date filters, sort, group-by; a row opens to the description, his own words, sources, branch and PR, and its feature matrix. Adds a permanent Build item to every context menu listing every build page. Data: data/asks.jsonl (seed) mirrored to the data folder; asks.mjs add | set-status | list keeps it current.
